column1: # Offline JSON-envelope smoke matrix, consumed by scripts/smoke.sh.
# Rows are argument LISTS, not quoted command strings — smoke.sh splits them
# with `set --`, so no row needs (or gets) shell quoting.
# Every row must be local-only: no network, no credits. Anything that can reach
# the ElevenLabs API belongs in the vitest suite behind a mock server, not here.
# A mistyped subcommand exits differently depending on the parent: registered
# parents (ops/config/spec) carry an action, so commander reports excess
# arguments -> exit 2, while alias parents have none and report an unknown
# command -> exit 9. Both rows pin the current contract; if you unify them,
